doc.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Upcoming plans
summary: Gordon heads home to San Diego and lists upcoming festivals, a symphony date and recordings.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I think everybody has to steal from somewhere. And where do you go from here?

Back to San Diego and to start my weekend job, then I’m playing with a group called Hal Smith’s Roadrunners, and we’re going to be, next month, a couple of weeks from now, two or three weeks from now we’re going to be in Sun Valley Idaho playing a jazz festival up there, and I’m looking forward to that, then we go to Scottsdale and then Palm Springs. I’m playing a date with the Palm Springs Symphony Orchestra, and then I’m playing here and there and then doing some more recordings. I’ve just had three recordings come out that I’m on and I have more coming out, making more coming up.
